# MM-P2-L3-IH03-S3 Calibration checks - Machining induction billet heater #3

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P2, line P2-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L3-IH03

Scope
- This document defines calibration check actions and inspection focus for Machining induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P2-L3-IH03). It supplements preventive maintenance and references safe work practices. See related documents MM-P2-L3-IH03, QS-PROC-10, SOP-P2-L3-01 for full maintenance and quality requirements.

Tools
- Multimeter suitable for induction heater diagnostics.
- Non-contact temperature verification device.
- Insulation resistance tester rated for equipment class.
- Clean lint-free cloth and approved lubricant CFW-LUB-725.
- Torque tools are not specified in this document; follow SOP-P2-L3-01 where torque values are required.

Procedure
- Verify lockout/tagout per SOP-P2-L3-01 before any access to EQ-P2-L3-IH03. Confirm power isolation and zero energy state.
- Visually inspect coil assembly for continuity of conductor, secure mounting, and signs of arcing or contamination. Record findings on the equipment inspection form referenced in MM-P2-L3-IH03.
- Measure insulation resistance of coil windings and compare to acceptance criteria in QS-PROC-10. Log measured values in the equipment history record.
- Perform function check of control interlocks and verify consistent response to operator inputs. Document any deviations and initiate corrective action per QS-PROC-10.
- Apply lubricant CFW-LUB-725 to specified mechanical wear points identified in MM-P2-L3-IH03. Use only the listed lubricant part number for this equipment.
- Note coil inspection frequency: the coil inspection interval for Machining induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P2-L3-IH03) is 390 hours. Schedule next inspection in the maintenance system accordingly.

Acceptance criteria
- Coil insulation resistance and continuity meet the limits defined in QS-PROC-10.
- No visible damage, arcing marks, or contamination on coil assembly that would affect operation.
- Control interlocks and safety devices operate reliably as per SOP-P2-L3-01.
- Lubrication completed using CFW-LUB-725 and recorded in the maintenance log.
- Any nonconforming condition addressed per MM-P2-L3-IH03 and closed in the corrective action record.
